lines.english: Mm...

lines.japanese: 夢か……？
lines.english: A dream...?

lines.japanese: お母さんだれと話してるの……そんなにどなっちゃダメだよ……。
lines.english: Mommy, who are you talking to...? You shouldn't yell like that...

lines.japanese: お父さん仕事でいそがしいんだから仕方ないよ……。
lines.english: Daddy's busy with work. He can't help it...

lines.japanese: お母さん……？
lines.english: Mommy...?

lines.japanese: ちがうこの声は……。
lines.english: No. That voice was...

lines.japanese: ポッポ？
lines.english: Poppo?

lines.japanese: うわっ。
lines.english: Whoa.

lines.japanese: これはひどい。もう午後に差しかかる時間じゃないか。
lines.english: This was bad. It was nearly afternoon.

lines.japanese: 時計を見てびっくりした。眠気もふっとんで布団もふっとんだ。
lines.english: One look at the clock blew the sleep out of me—and the covers right off the bed.

lines.japanese: つうかよく考えてみれば、朝まで現場で仕事してたんだからそりゃこれくらいの時間になるよな。
lines.english: Though now that I thought about it, I had worked at the site until morning. Of course it was this late.

lines.japanese: でもポッ……小鳩が朝食の準備をしてくれてたんだとすれば悪いことしたなあ。
lines.english: But if Pop—if Kobato had made me breakfast, I’d feel bad for sleeping through it.

lines.japanese: 頭を振って体を起こす。
lines.english: I shook my head and sat up.

lines.japanese: 夢を見ていた気もするけどよく覚えていない。
lines.english: I had a feeling I'd been dreaming, but I couldn't remember it clearly.

lines.japanese: とりあえず小鳩に謝ってこよう。まだ疲れの残る体を引きずりながら一階へと下った。
lines.english: First things first: apologize to Kobato. I dragged my still-weary body downstairs.

lines.japanese: 「あっ」
lines.english: “Ah.”

lines.japanese: 「おはよう」
lines.english: “Morning.”

lines.japanese: ちょうど小鳩が居間から出てきたところだった。
lines.english: Kobato had just come out of the living room.

lines.japanese: 「おはよおー」
lines.english: “Good morniiing.”

lines.japanese: なんだか機嫌が良さそうだ。楽しいのはいいことだ、うん。
lines.english: She seemed to be in a good mood. Having fun is a good thing. Yeah.

lines.japanese: 「昨日はおつかれさまだったね」
lines.english: “You must've had a long day yesterday.”

lines.japanese: 「うん。久しぶりだから体が鈍ってたみたいで、ひどい筋肉痛だ。エネルギーも使いはたしたみたい」
lines.english: “Yeah. It'd been a while, so I guess my body's gone soft. My muscles are killing me, and I seem to have burned through every last drop of energy.”

lines.japanese: 「じゃあおなか空いてる？」
lines.english: “Then are you hungry?”

lines.japanese: 「え、まあまあ……」
lines.english: “Uh, kind of...”

lines.japanese: 「そっかあ……ごめんねお兄ちゃん。私、お母さんに頼まれごとしちゃって、これから出かけないといけないんだあ。今からすぐに支度するから、それを食べてもらってもいい？」
lines.english: “Oh... Sorry, big bro. Mom gave me an errand, and I have to go out now. I’ll make you something right away—would you be okay eating that?”

lines.japanese: 「あれ？　朝ごはんは？」
lines.english: “Huh? What about breakfast?”

lines.japanese: 「えっ？　いまお昼だよ？」
lines.english: “What? It's lunchtime now.”

lines.japanese: 「うん」
lines.english: “Right.”

lines.japanese: 「♪おっひる、おひる～」
lines.english: “♪ Luuunch—luuunch~”

lines.japanese: いまの会話におかしな点がなかったか考えている間に、小鳩は台所へ向かっていった。
lines.english: While I stood there wondering whether something had been wrong with that exchange, Kobato headed into the kitchen.

lines.japanese: 「ああそうだ、出かけるってどこに？」
lines.english: “Oh, right. You said you were going out. Where to?”

lines.japanese: 「はえっ？」
lines.english: “Hwuh?”

lines.japanese: 「さっき叔母さんに頼まれごとしたって言ってなかった？」
lines.english: “Didn't you just say Auntie asked you to run an errand?”

lines.japanese: 「あ、うん」
lines.english: “Oh, yeah.”

lines.japanese: 「えと、このメモ」
lines.english: “Um... this note.”

lines.japanese: 「内藤さん」
lines.english: “Naito...”

lines.japanese: 「うん。さっき旅行先から電話があって、お歳暮を出しわすれた相手がいるから、今日中に送ってほしいって頼まれたの」
lines.english: “Yeah. She called from her trip a little while ago. There's somebody she forgot to send a year-end gift to, so she asked me to mail one today.”

lines.japanese: 小鳩、ジャージで行く気なのかな。
lines.english: Was Kobato planning to go in that tracksuit?

lines.japanese: 「一人で行くの？」
lines.english: “Are you going alone?”

lines.japanese: 「えっ」
lines.english: “What?”

lines.japanese: 戻ってきた。なにか言いたそうにしてる。
lines.english: She came back. She looked as though she wanted to say something.

lines.japanese: 「どこまで行くの」
lines.english: “How far are you going?”

lines.japanese: 「柳木原……」
lines.english: “Yanagihara...”

lines.japanese: 「一人で大丈夫なのか」
lines.english: “Will you be all right on your own?”

lines.japanese: 「う、うん、それは大丈夫だと思うけど……」
lines.english: “Y-yes. I think *that* part will be okay, but...”

lines.japanese: それはってなんだ。それこそが心配なのに。
lines.english: What did she mean, *that* part? That was the very part I was worried about.

lines.japanese: 「ちなみになに買うの」
lines.english: “What are you buying, anyway?”

lines.japanese: 「うーん、行ってから決めようと思ってるけど、二千円くらいだからお米とかかなあ」
lines.english: “Hmm... I thought I'd decide once I got there. The budget's about two thousand yen, so maybe rice?”

lines.japanese: 「一緒に行こう」
lines.english: “I'm coming with you.”

lines.japanese: お歳暮に米を送るような妹を、ひとりにはできない。
lines.english: I couldn't leave a sister who would send somebody rice as a year-end gift to fend for herself.

lines.japanese: 「えっ、ホント！？」
lines.english: “What? Really!?”

lines.japanese: 「まあ、どうせ今日は一日空いてるし。柳木原だったら定期もあるから交通費もかからないし」
lines.english: “Well, I have the whole day free anyway. And I have a commuter pass to Yanagihara, so getting there won't cost me anything.”

lines.japanese: 「うん、うんっ」
lines.english: “Yes. Yes!”

lines.japanese: 「ついでだからお昼も外で食べよう。だから用意しなくてもいいよ」
lines.english: “We can get lunch while we're out. You don't need to make anything.”

lines.japanese: 「了解であります！」
lines.english: “Sir, yes, sir!”

lines.japanese: 小鳩が指をまっすぐ伸ばして額に当てる。これだけ楽しそうにしてもらえると、一緒に行く甲斐があるなあ。
lines.english: Kobato straightened her fingers and pressed them to her forehead in a salute. If going together made her this happy, it was already worth the trip.

lines.japanese: 「じゃあ俺が顔洗ってる間に準備してきなさい」
lines.english: “All right. Go get ready while I wash my face.”

lines.japanese: 「準備？」
lines.english: “Ready?”

lines.japanese: 「あっ、そうだね。じゃあ私着替えてくるっ」
lines.english: “Oh! Right. I'll go change!”

lines.japanese: やっぱりジャージで行く気だったのか。
lines.english: So she really had meant to go in that tracksuit.

lines.japanese: 小鳩はリズムよく階段を上がっていった。
lines.english: Kobato bounded up the stairs, her steps falling into a cheerful rhythm.

lines.japanese: というわけで休日の柳木原。まだ午後１時を過ぎてないのに結構な人出だ。
lines.english: So: Yanagihara on a day off. It wasn't even one in the afternoon, and already the crowds were out in force.

lines.japanese: 「おい小鳩、はぐれるなよ」
lines.english: “Hey, Kobato. Don't get separated from me.”

lines.japanese: 時すでに遅し。
lines.english: Too late.

lines.japanese: 「こ、こばとっ」
lines.english: “K-Kobato!”

lines.japanese: 「おお、お兄ちゃんっ」
lines.english: “Oh! Big bro!”

lines.japanese: 声を頼りに探しだした小鳩は、知らないおばさんに謝っていた。いわく、ぶつかって転んだ拍子にビニール袋をクラッシュしたらしい。幸い壊れやすいものは入っていなかったので、謝るだけで許してもらえた。
lines.english: I followed her voice and found Kobato apologizing to a woman I didn't know. Apparently they had collided, Kobato had fallen, and the woman's plastic shopping bag had been crushed in the process. Fortunately it contained nothing fragile, and the woman let her go with an apology.

lines.japanese: 「もおー、だーからポッポは一人でひょいひょいあるくなって言ってるでしょー、もーう」
lines.english: “Sheeesh! This is why I keep telling Poppo not to go flitting off on her own! Honestly!”

lines.japanese: 「かか返す言葉もない」
lines.english: “I-I-I have no words in my defense.”

lines.japanese: 驚きのあまり、思わず言葉がバカヨージになってしまった。小鳩も言葉ヘンだし。
lines.english: My surprise had made the idiot Yoji voice slip out. Kobato's words were coming out funny too.
“...Uuuh.”

lines.japanese: まあ元から怒ったりなんてしてないけど、この妹に怒れと言うのがムリだ。
lines.english: Not that I had been angry in the first place. How was anyone supposed to stay angry with a sister like this?

lines.japanese: ジャージで出かける気満々だったくせに、なんだろうこの気合いの入り方は。ちくしょうかわいいじゃないか羽田小鳩。
lines.english: She had been all set to go out in a tracksuit, yet look how much effort she'd put in now. Damn you for being so adorable, Kobato Haneda.

lines.japanese: 「ほら、ひとが少ないところに出るまで、手を繋いで歩こう」
lines.english: “Here. Until we get somewhere less crowded, let's hold hands.”

lines.japanese: 俺は目を逸らすために、出口に顔を向けながら右手を後ろに伸ばした。
lines.english: I turned toward the exit to hide my face and held my right hand out behind me.

lines.japanese: 「はえっ？」
lines.english: “Hwuh?”

lines.japanese: その後ろから聞こえる疑問符つきの声。
lines.english: Her puzzled voice rose behind me with a question mark in it.

lines.japanese: 「えっ」
lines.english: “Huh?”

lines.japanese: な、なんで驚いた顔で見るんだよ。なんかヘンなこと言ったかな俺。
lines.english: W-why was she staring at me in shock? Had I said something strange?

lines.japanese: いや言ってないよな。だって兄妹で手を繋いだってなんら不自然じゃないからな。おう、兄妹だもんな。
lines.english: No. Of course I hadn't. There was nothing remotely unnatural about a brother and sister holding hands. Right. We were brother and sister.

lines.japanese: 「いいの？」
lines.english: “Is it okay?”

lines.japanese: 「ば、バカ、そんな、許可とるようなことか」
lines.english: “D-don't be silly. It's hardly something you need permission for.”

lines.japanese: 「う、うんっ」
lines.english: “O-okay.”

lines.japanese: 「うん、うんっ！」
lines.english: “Okay! Okay!”

lines.japanese: 小鳩は何度も頷いてから左手を伸ばしてきた。小さな手が俺の指を包みこむ。
lines.english: Kobato nodded again and again, then reached out her left hand. Her small hand closed around my fingers.

lines.japanese: 俺もその指へ重ねるように手を握る。
lines.english: I curled my hand around hers in turn.

lines.japanese: 柔らかい肌の感触がふわりと指に伝わってきた。
lines.english: The softness of her skin brushed faintly against my fingers.

lines.japanese: 「そ、そういえば昔もこんなことあったな」
lines.english: “C-come to think of it, we did this once before.”

lines.japanese: 俺は照れ隠しに――いや照れてないけど、郷愁感を出して恥ずかしさを中和させようとした。
lines.english: To hide my embarrassment—no, I wasn't embarrassed—I tried to dilute the awkwardness with a dose of nostalgia.

lines.japanese: 「電車に乗ってちょっと遠出したときに、二人で手を繋いで歩いたよな」
lines.english: “That time we took the train somewhere a little farther away, we walked around holding hands too.”

lines.japanese: 「ほらまだ小さかった頃、あんまり小鳩が泣くからどっか遠くにでも行ってみようかって話をして――」
lines.english: “Remember? We were still little. You wouldn't stop crying, so we talked about going somewhere far away together—”

lines.japanese: 「えっ」
lines.english: “What?”

lines.japanese: 握った手に力がこもるのを感じた。
lines.english: I felt her hand tighten around mine.

lines.japanese: あれ？　そのときってなんで小鳩が泣いてたんだっけ……。
lines.english: Wait. Why had Kobato been crying that time...?

lines.japanese: 「そうそう、母さんが……」
lines.english: “That's right. Mom was...”

lines.japanese: おかしいな、なんでだろう。俺覚えてる。
lines.english: That was strange. Why? I remembered this.

lines.japanese: 鷹志も鷲介も隼人も子供の頃のことって思いださなかったのに、なんでこんなに簡単に景色が浮かぶんだろ。
lines.english: Takashi, Shusuke, Hayato—none of them had ever recalled anything from childhood. So why did the scene come back to me this easily?

lines.japanese: 今まで考えなかったのか、考えても思いだせなかったのか分からないけど、今は自然と頭に浮かぶ――
lines.english: I didn't know whether I had simply never thought about it before, or had thought and failed to remember. But now it rose naturally into my mind—

lines.japanese: 「いでっ」
lines.english: “Ow!”

lines.japanese: ぼけっとしてたら改札から流れてきたひとに肩がぶつかった。
lines.english: Lost in thought, I knocked shoulders with somebody coming through the ticket gates.

lines.japanese: 「お兄ちゃん、どうしたの？」
lines.english: “Big brother? What’s wrong?”

lines.japanese: そうだ、なにもいま昔のことを思い出さなくてもいいだろ。時間のあるときにゆっくり考えればいい。
lines.english: Right. I didn't have to dredge up the past here and now. I could sit down and think it through when I had time.

lines.japanese: 「むかし小鳩が初めて柳木原に来たときに、あんまり大きいから怖くて泣きだしたんだよな」
lines.english: “When you first came to Yanagihara, it was so big and scary you burst into tears. Remember?”

lines.japanese: 「ふえっ？」
lines.english: “Hwuh?”

lines.japanese: 「そ、そんなことしてないっ」
lines.english: “I-I did no such thing!”

lines.japanese: 「まったくポッポったら小っせーころからおかしなトコだけ度胸あっだで。家ん中すっぱだかではしりまわったりしてよ」
lines.english: “Aw, Poppo, you've always been brave about the strangest things, even when you were tiny. You used to run around the house stark naked and everything.”

lines.japanese: 「し、してないようっ！　そんなんっ、してないで！」
lines.english: “I-I didn't! I never did anything like that!”

lines.japanese: 「したした」
lines.english: “You did, you did.”

lines.japanese: 「しし、してないっ！　忘れてっ！」
lines.english: “I-I-I didn't! Forget it!”

lines.japanese: 「忘れてってことはしたんじゃん」
lines.english: “Telling me to forget means you did it.”
“Hwuh...”

lines.japanese: 「あっ！」
lines.english: “Ah!”

lines.japanese: 「ああああお兄ちゃんがごめんなさい、そうだ甘いもの食べる？　お兄ちゃん今なら何でもごちそうしてあげるよ？」
lines.english: “Aaaah, Big Brother's sorry! I'm so sorry! Want something sweet? Big Brother will buy you absolutely anything right now, okay?”

lines.japanese: 「えへへ、タイヤキー」
lines.english: “Hee hee. A little fish-shaped cake!”

lines.japanese: 「ううう、何でもと言ってるのに迷わず浮かんだのがそれなんて、たんとお食べ。好きなだけお食べ」
lines.english: “Uuugh. I offer you anything in the world, and that's what comes to mind without a second's thought. Then eat your fill. Have as many as you like.”

lines.japanese: 俺と小鳩は駅を出て、柳木原の中心へと向かった。
lines.english: Kobato and I left the station and headed into central Yanagihara.

lines.japanese: そうだ、めんどくさいことはあとで全部考えればいい。
lines.english: Right. I could leave all the troublesome thinking until later.
